description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) scores across different methods as the number of queries used during inference increases from 2 to 10. The x-axis, labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)", is scaled linearly with integer values ranging from 2 to 10. The y-axis, labeled "MRR@10", ranges from 33.0 to 36.0 and is also linearly scaled. Four methods are compared: DPR w/o query (black solid line), DPR w/ corpus expansion (red solid line with circular markers), DPR w/ document expansion (green solid line with triangular markers), and DPR w/ asymmetric expansion (blue solid line with star markers). The DPR w/o query method remains relatively constant at approximately 34.05 across all query counts. The DPR w/ corpus expansion method shows a consistent increase in MRR@10, starting at approximately 34.6 and rising to about 35.8. The DPR w/ document expansion method begins at around 34.5 and exhibits a slight decline, ending at approximately 34.5. The DPR w/ asymmetric expansion method starts at about 34.5, peaks at around 34.7 at 2 queries, and then gradually decreases to approximately 34.4 by 10 queries.
